blocks.raw: # Dataflow Versioning

Neo dataflows are version-controlled. By default, a dataflow, when created, is in version `v1
` and in the `Draft` state, allowing users with edit access to compose the dataflow.
blocks.text:
Neo dataflows are version-controlled. By default, a dataflow, when created, is in version v1
 and in the Draft state, allowing users with edit access to compose the dataflow.

blocks.raw: When a Neo Admin approves a version under review, the system automatically creates a new version with the next consecutive number. This new version starts in the Draft state and is a copy of the recently approved version, allowing further modifications.
blocks.text: When a Neo Admin approves a version under review, the system automatically creates a new version with the next consecutive number. This new version starts in the Draft state and is a copy of the recently approved version, allowing further modifications.

blocks.raw: ## Compare versions
You can compare code changes between different versions of a dataflow.
blocks.text: You can compare code changes between different versions of a dataflow.

blocks.raw: To compare versions,

1. In the dataflow composing page, click on the version compare icon.\
   The compare versions window opens.
2. In the compare versions window, use the drop-down to select any two versions to compare.
blocks.text: In the dataflow composing page, click on the version compare icon.The compare versions window opens.In the compare versions window, use the drop-down to select any two versions to compare.

blocks.raw: **Note**:  The icon is available only for dataflows in the `Draft` state.
blocks.text: Note:  The icon is available only for dataflows in the Draft state.

blocks.raw: ## Restore a version
You can revert the current version of the dataflow to the most recently approved version.
blocks.text: You can revert the current version of the dataflow to the most recently approved version.

blocks.raw: To restore a version,

1. In the dataflow composing page, click on the restore version icon.\
   A Revert Rule modal appears.
2. Enter the dataflow name.
3. Click **Yes.**
blocks.text: In the dataflow composing page, click on the restore version icon.A Revert Rule modal appears.Enter the dataflow name.Click Yes.

blocks.raw: The version is restored to the most recently approved version.
blocks.text: The version is restored to the most recently approved version.

blocks.raw: ## Version listing page
The version listing page lists the different versions of a dataflow.
blocks.text: The version listing page lists the different versions of a dataflow.

blocks.raw: To access the version listing page, on the **Dataflows** page, click on the intended dataflow.
blocks.text: To access the version listing page, on the Dataflows page, click on the intended dataflow.
